_note: Juniper round 2 (Nov 5, Claude picks with Tiffany notes; site/livepatch/juniper-picks-nov04/build_r2.py). DRAFT order until she confirms. Rack keys -> names in rack_keys.

mats.name: Garden Glow – Emerald Green
mats.why: Looks made for the set: the deep forest ground is the jade-look back, and the pink wildflowers and greens pick up the craks, bams and dots.

mats.name: Palm Royale
mats.why: Kelly cane lattice, blush palms and leopards: pink and green at the same brightness as the faces, with enough green to hold the backs.

mats.name: Lotus Cove
mats.why: Oh My Mahjong's own pair for Juniper (starter kit, Nov 11). Pink pond frame and lily pads echo the lotus flower tiles; it has no forest green, so it sits third.

mats.name: Botanical Jewel
mats.why: Forest green ground full of magenta and pink wildflowers: back, bams and craks in one.

mats.name: Esme
mats.why: Deep teal-green with pink blossoms, an Oh My Mahjong cousin of the set. Retired, but still a match for anyone who owns it.

mats.name: Emerald Leopard in Bloom
mats.why: Emerald lattice frame with pink peonies; the leopard keeps it playful, like the jester jokers.

mats.name: Midori Shadows
mats.why: Deep green with cranes and pink blossoms: the garden-at-night mood of the set. Also one of your Malachite picks.

mats.name: Reba
mats.why: Deep green field inside a pink frame, with a bouquet of pinks and greens.

mats.name: Mahj In Bloom Mat
mats.why: Deep green with pink and orchid roses; the lilac border is the only colour Juniper doesn't carry.

mats.name: Savannah
mats.why: Forest green with a pink floral medallion. Its olive and orange make it the moodier, Thanksgiving-to-Christmas pick.

mats.name: Viola
mats.why: Deep green center inside a dark floral border of pinks and lilacs: elegant and dark.

mats.name: YOTD Black
mats.why: Black ground with pink roses and a green dragon, for the emerald dragon tiles. The darkest pick here.

mats.name: Sunday Premium
mats.why: Teal-green with a coral crane, the peacock tile's cousin; the gold trim picks up the gold dots.

mats.name: Crane & Moon
mats.why: Deep green-navy night sky with cranes, coral flowers and a gold moon: the lantern-lit garden in OMM's own words.

mats.name: Enchanted
mats.why: Hot pink and kelly green chinoiserie from Oh My Mahjong: the same pink and green, at the same brightness as the faces. Retired.

mats.name: Peonies Burst
mats.why: Magenta peonies around a kelly green star: bold, and right on Juniper's pink and green.

mats.name: Zesty Plume
mats.why: Hits every Juniper colour: hot pink frame, teal and chartreuse foliage, and a white field like the faces.

mats.name: Chinoiserie Songbird
mats.why: A chinoiserie garden in pink, mint and lime: the world of the peacock and pagoda tiles.

mats.name: Cherry Blossom Jade
mats.why: Hot pink, chartreuse and kelly: all three of Juniper's loud colours in one mat.

mats.name: Day Dreamer (Pink and Green)
mats.why: Hot pink and lime medallion: picks up the chartreuse layer and the pink dots.

mats.name: Tropical Travels
mats.why: Pink, kelly and teal tropical leaves: preppy and bright.

mats.name: Palm Beach Tropical Pink Lime
mats.why: The chartreuse layer's best friend: a lime centre inside a hot pink tropical frame.

mats.name: Cheetah in Chinoiserie
mats.why: A pagoda garden in pinks and greens under a navy sky, like the pagoda and flower tiles. Etsy, through ShopMy.

mats.name: Whimsical Chinoiserie Meeting in the Pavilion
mats.why: Pagodas, pink blossoms and green gardens: the flower tiles as a full scene. Etsy, through ShopMy.

mats.name: Grand Rose Medallion Chinoiserie
mats.why: Pink roses on big green lily pads around a medallion, close to the lotus flower tiles.

mats.name: YOTD Pink
mats.why: Blush ground, pink roses and a green dragon: the dragon tiles, softened.

mats.name: YOTD White
mats.why: White ground like the faces, with roses and a teal dragon: the lightest of the dragon mats.

mats.name: The Dahlia
mats.why: Soft pink and teal-green toile: the quiet option that lets the faces do the talking.

mats.name: Green Bamboo Blossoms
mats.why: Bamboo lattice with pink blossoms, like the bam tiles. Its sage green is softer and a little earthier than the backs.

mats.name: Green Malachite
mats.why: A green stone pattern that echoes the jade-look backs. Tone on tone; the faces bring the pink.

mats.name: Evergreen
mats.why: Deep green with ferns: tone on tone, like the backs. One of your Malachite picks.

mats.name: Emerald Cove
mats.why: A swirled emerald that looks like the tile backs themselves. Sleek and moody.

mats.name: Emerald Teal & Celadon Leatherette
mats.why: The solid pick: the emerald side matches the teal layer, and the celadon side flips it softer.
